title: Under the weather: two friends talk about health

script.text: Jack! Oh no, you look awful. Are you all right?
Hi, Olivia. Honestly, I've been a bit under the weather all week. I feel completely run-down.
Poor you! Have you been to the doctor?
Not yet. I'm going for a check-up on Friday. I think it's just stress. The exams finished last Tuesday, but I'm still exhausted.
Well, no wonder. You were burning the candle at both ends for weeks. I saw you in the library at midnight!
I know, I know. I'm a real night owl. I can't concentrate in the mornings, so I work late and then sleep for five hours.
Five hours? That's not nearly enough!
Ha, my mum says the same. She keeps telling me to eat properly, too. But I never have time. I usually skip breakfast and grab a sandwich on my way to school.
Eating on the go all the time isn't good for you either. And what about lunch?
Mostly crisps and a fizzy drink. I know it's junk food, but it's quick.

Oh, Jack! No wonder your immune system is so weak. Listen, I used to be exactly the same. Last year I caught three colds in two months. Then my aunt, who's a nutritionist, helped me to cut down on sugar and eat more fruit and vegetables.
Totally! I haven't been ill since September. I still have a little chocolate now and then, of course. I also bought a fitness tracker, which tells me when to go to bed. It's actually fun.
A fitness tracker? I'm not sure about that. I spend too much time looking at screens as it is.
That's true. Well, then start with something simple. Put your phone away an hour before bed.
Hmm, that's going to be hard. But OK, I'll give it a go.
Great! And if you feel better by Saturday, come cycling with us.
Deal! Thanks, Olivia. You've cheered me up.

statements: Jack has already had a medical check-up.
Jack works late at night because he finds it hard to concentrate in the morning.
Jack's mother is worried about the way he eats.
The canteen at Jack's school serves unhealthy food.
Olivia's aunt helped her to improve her diet.
Olivia has completely given up sugar.
